skill_name: My child is becoming too dependent on technology - what could I do to fix this?
workflow: There are some steps that you can take to address this concern. Firstly, it’s important to set a good example yourself by cutting down on the usage of technology, particularly in front of your child. Some other ideas include setting tech-free times and places in the house, such as during meal times or in the bedroom; setting up rules on device usage, such as a ban on screens during the week; and helping your child find alternative activities, such as outdoor play, reading, or taking up a hobby.
